title: Versioned workload, capacity, cost and failure model

scope.model: A versioned atlas.capacity-model/v1 local planning model with steady, peak, burst and abuse profiles.
scope.distribution: Tenant tiers and provider quota shares are explicit and validated to sum to one.
scope.cost: Per-profile inference tokens, tool calls, provider events, media bytes and receipts reconcile to deterministic mission/action estimates.
scope.faults: Ingress, coordination, inference, action, provider and reconciliation fault entries declare expected behavior and containment.
scope.confidence: The model records an explicit 0.5–0.8 planning confidence range and does not claim observed capacity or SLOs.

acceptance_coverage: Steady, peak, burst and abuse profiles are versioned.
Tenant distribution and provider quotas are explicit and validated.
Per-mission and per-action modeled cost drivers are measurable and reconciled.
Assumptions and confidence bounds are explicit.
Malformed distributions, duplicate/missing profiles and invalid cost drivers are rejected.
No production mutation or external provider operation is performed.
remaining_gate_requirements: Disposable load environment required by the work-item gate
Observed workload traces and independently reproduced capacity envelope
Provider-specific quotas and production topology measurements
Hosted staging, production, usage/cost ledger, billing, commercial and whole-product certification evidence
verdict: ATLAS-BMR2-P4-002 is LOCAL_PROVEN but remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL because no disposable load environment, observed workload trace or production capacity evidence is available. The model is a planning fixture, not a production capacity claim.
limitations: Absent proof remains: disposable load environment, observed workload trace, production capacity envelope, provider sandbox, CI, staging, production, usage/cost ledger, billing settlement, commercial readiness, whole-product certification.
